youtube.title: Why a Town Has Been on Fire for 60 Years #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Smoke rises from the road. The ground is warm in winter. Since 1962, a fire has been burning under Centralia, Pennsylvania, and it may burn for centuries more.

How one rubbish fire reached an old coal mine, why nobody could put it out, and why moving an entire town was the cheaper choice.

instagram.caption:
A fire has been burning under this town since 1962. 🔥

One rubbish fire reached an old coal mine. Putting it out would have cost $663 million with no guarantee, so America moved the town instead. It could burn for 250 more years.
